body.message:
We can offer AED 5,500 per month for the first three months, followed by AED 6,000 per month for the subsequent three months. Please note that this is an all-inclusive rate with no hidden charges.

Kindly be advised that daily housekeeping is not included. However, if required, we can arrange cleaning services at an additional cost.

Should you wish to view the apartment prior to making a reservation, we would be happy to arrange a viewing at your convenience.
